title: I Bought Two Of These: They Both Failed
text:
I Bought Two Of These: They Both Failed. I Bought Two of these: one in February 2016 and one in December 2015. They both failed completely in about 6 months. The pump motors died. I tried several sets of batteries (testing them with a great battery tester first, to make sure the issue was not the batteries).

It is mind-boggling that in this technological age, Simplehuman cannot get this product right, especially after the countless reports of failures. (Both this model and the rechargeable model which costs $10 more have so many reports of failures in a relatively short time.)
